# WIYO

> WIYO is a web-based real estate CRM for UAE brokerages. It brings property leads, conversations, inventory context, team follow-up, and management visibility into one operating workspace. AI-assisted workflows help summarise context, prioritise work, prepare drafts, and match buyer requirements with relevant inventory; people remain responsible for decisions and customer communication.

Official website: https://www.wiyo.ae/
Primary language and market: English; United Arab Emirates
Contact: hello@wiyo.ae | WhatsApp: +971 58 615 2039

## Product and solution pages

- [Home](https://www.wiyo.ae/): Product positioning, workflow overview, pricing, FAQ, and live-demo request.
- [Real Estate CRM Dubai](https://www.wiyo.ae/real-estate-crm-dubai): Dubai brokerage lead, conversation, inventory, and team workflows.
- [UAE Real Estate CRM](https://www.wiyo.ae/uae-real-estate-crm): UAE-focused workflows and multi-emirate team use cases.
- [Off-Plan CRM UAE](https://www.wiyo.ae/off-plan-crm-uae): Project information, buyer requirements, availability context, and reservation progress.
- [Property-portal lead workflows](https://www.wiyo.ae/bayut-property-finder-crm): Lead intake, assignment, deduplication, and response operations.
- [WhatsApp CRM Dubai](https://www.wiyo.ae/whatsapp-crm-dubai): Shared conversation workflows, CRM context, and AI-assisted drafts.

Exact connection methods, source availability, security details, data residency, implementation timelines, and contractual commitments depend on the buyer's deployment and must be confirmed during procurement.
